name: imagegen
description: Generate and edit images from Claude Code with your own API key: Google Gemini (Nano Banana), OpenAI gpt-image, or any image model on OpenRouter. Images are saved straight into your project.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Google AI Studio key (aistudio.google.com/apikey). Image models need billing enabled on the key's project. Leave empty if unused.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: OpenAI platform key for gpt-image models. Leave empty if unused.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: One key for many image models (Gemini, GPT image and others) via openrouter.ai. Leave empty if unused.

default_provider.title: Default provider
default_provider.description: auto picks the first provider with a key, in the order gemini, openai, openrouter.

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Where images are saved when no output_path is given, relative to the project root.
